title: 喜欢住车里的年轻人，把民宿泡沫挤破了？
content: China’s automotive landscape is transforming as vehicles evolve from basic transport into affordable private sanctuaries. Amidst high housing costs, urbanites increasingly utilize cars for rest and solitude, driving up demand for "bed car" configurations. Manufacturers now offer extensive amenities and rapid model iterations to meet these lifestyle needs. Consequently, the average time spent inside cars has grown significantly, redefining automobiles as a flexible fourth space. This shift complicates consumer choices while highlighting the car's new role as a refuge from societal pressures, fundamentally altering how modern Chinese society utilizes mobile living spaces.

title: 大动脉辞职了怎么办
content: Jensen Huang is stepping down as NVIDIA's CEO, with Colette Kress assuming the role temporarily. The market reacted positively to competitors' gains but remained anxious due to Huang's central role in the company's unique, flat organizational structure. Unlike other tech firms, NVIDIA lacks a designated successor. Huang has long defined NVIDIA's strategy by anticipating computing bottlenecks, driving innovations in networking and memory. Future success depends on executing complex technologies like NVHBM and 800V power delivery, a responsibility deeply tied to Huang's personal leadership and industry insight.

title: 修道院成了夜总会，牵出影后藏了30年的秘密 | 原文
content: The 1992 film *Sister Act* features Whoopi Goldberg as a nightclub singer who hides in a convent after witnessing a murder, transforming the nuns’ choir into a successful performance group. Beyond the movie, Goldberg’s personal history is equally compelling. Born in a New York City housing project to a single mother, she suffered from severe dyslexia and dropped out of school at a young age, yet she eventually rose to become a celebrated Hollywood legend.
